usageNotes: Use this endpoint to discard stuck or unwanted queued subscription changes in bulk without touching the remote nodes — useful when a target node is offline or gone and you want to unblock the pool without first bringing the remote back online. Only entries the caller has `System.Modify` on are affected; entries where the caller only has audit access are silently skipped. Pass the current config `digest` to guard against concurrent admin edits overwriting each other.

examples.summary: Clear all pending subscription changes with optimistic-lock protection

tips: The response `cleared` count reflects how many pool entries were actually modified; a result of 0 means no pending changes matched your privilege scope.
Omit `digest` for a force-clear when you do not have the current config hash at hand, accepting the risk of overwriting a concurrent change.
This operation is the discard counterpart to `post_subscriptions_apply_pending` — prefer apply-pending when the remote is reachable and you want the changes pushed rather than dropped.
Entries where the remote is unreachable have their binding returned to the free pool; the live key on the remote is not modified by this call.
